app.name: Frankfurter
app.one_liner: An open-source currency data API that aggregates and blends daily exchange rates from over 50 institutional sources into a mathematically consistent USD-anchored model.

screens.name: API Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display available endpoints, provider coverage, and usage instructions for the Frankfurter currency API.
primary_actions: Fetch historical rates by date range

rust_commands.name: fetch_blended_rates
rust_commands.purpose: Retrieve blended exchange rates from multiple institutional providers for specified base/quote currencies and date(s).

rust_commands.name: list_providers
rust_commands.purpose: Return metadata about all integrated institutional data sources including coverage, country codes, and rate types.

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement Dockerized deployment with SQLite persistence
week 1: Integrate at least three central bank APIs (e.g., Banxico, BOT, FRED)
acceptance_tests: Cross-rate triangles (e.g., EUR→USD→JPY vs EUR→JPY) round to 1.0 within 5 decimal places due to USD anchoring.
Date-range queries to /v2/rates return consistent rates matching single-date queries for each day in the range.
Self-hosted instance with mounted volume retains historical rate data across container restarts.
